title: People’s Mañanera August 12
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Mexico Achieves Its Best Performance Ever at the Central American Games  
** The national team won 407 medals and secured its third consecutive Central
American championship. “They fill all of Mexico with pride,” said President
Claudia Sheinbaum. Each medal will now be rewarded, and in 2027, scholarships
will increase by at least 10%. “There will be no shortage of funding,” the
President declared.

**Sports Foster Discipline, Confidence, and Pride  
** From school to elite competition, sports transform lives and open doors.
“It represents discipline, self-confidence, and collective learning,” the
President explained. Furthermore, the champions serve as role models for new
generations and are a source of pride for Mexico.

**Mexico Aims Higher on the Road to Lima 2027 and Los Angeles 2028  
** “We must do away with the idea that Mexicans are inferior. We are just like
anyone else in the world,” Sheinbaum said. With support and planning, a new
generation is set to break the Olympic record at Los Angeles 2028.

**Housing for Well-being is Making Strong Progress  
** In Yucatán, 66% of the administration’s six-year goal of 72,770 homes has
been achieved, and 2026 is expected to close with 91% of Infonavit’s target
met. In August, 34,300 people received homes nationwide, making access to
decent housing, home ownership, and shared prosperity a reality.

**Mexico Extends a Helping Hand to Colombia  
** In response to the earthquakes in Colombia, Mexico sent two Air Force
carriers with 19.5 metric tons of humanitarian aid and will continue to send
food supplies, water, and medicine. In addition, efforts are underway to
ensure the safe return of the stranded Mexican youth soccer team.

**“Incredible”: The Mexican Peso Remains Strong  
** Sheinbaum hailed the peso’s strength against the dollar. The current
exchange rate is 17.3 pesos to the U.S. dollar. This is good news for the
Mexican economy, reflecting the stability and confidence the peso maintains
against the dollar.
